summary: Phase 4 adversarial re-audit at 944f6128 after Red closed ADV-7, ADV-8, and ADV-9. The diff b8022222..944f6128 was read: check-records.sh gains the ADV-7 column-count guard (every TSV data row must hold exactly 4 tab-separated columns), the ADV-8 masked in-order compare (cut -f1-3 sha256 of the whole TSV against the phase base, which fails a pure row reorder), and the ADV-9 P4-f civic grep set (the track id plus the TSV path, locations/civic/, and scenes/maps/<slug>.ts, docs/map-mockups/<slug>, scripts/design-<slug>.mjs per slug). The checker grew from 44 to 46 checks and the live tree passes 46 of 46 with exit 0. Two harness defects in adversarial-p4.sh were fixed as instructed: the script no longer pins a SHA (it captures git rev-parse HEAD at run time, so it survives later commits including its own), and it now reuses the shared clone when it sits at the audited head and recreates it when it sits at another head (this run exercised both paths: recreate from b8022222, then reuse at 944f6128); the control compares against the live checker total parsed from the committed-tree run (46), never a fixed number. All twelve probes are CAUGHT with their exact expected lines: the four former gaps now fail the gate (a trailing tab adding a 5th column fails 'P4-a TSV data rows hold a column count other than 4 at lines' plus a bonus P4-f FAIL because the doctor itself flags the malformed row and the widened grep set names the TSV path; the apothecary/archive reorder fails the masked-compare FAIL alone, exit 1 with PASS=45 FAIL=1, exactly the guard Red added; a doctor line naming scenes/maps/mill.ts through a broken tech-debt link fails 'P4-f doctor output names this track or its civic files'; a dropped scope-map row locations/civic/mill fails the same check), and the eight standing defenses held (follow-up against an accepted inventory cell, non-civic P0 status edit, trailing space, non-civic reorder, one-character generator drift caught by the byte compare while the yaw grep still passes, one-byte map-review.html edit, and the 4-character e2c7 citation failing P4-d for all 30 changed slugs). No live instance exists for any probed defect class: the control clone passes 46 of 46, its doctor output holds 51 foreign error lines and none names scenes/maps/* or locations/civic/*, no TSV data row holds a column count other than 4, and the base and head cut -f1-3 sha256 are both f608396a. This role changed no checker, no record, no inventory, no plan, and no map; every mutation lived in the /tmp clone and was reset after each probe. One earlier harness bug in the script itself (a trailing space in a probe-order string compare made ADV-P4-04a report PROBE VOID once) was fixed before this final run; the committed script and log agree.
